Task: Given a screen recording at /app/video.mp4 of someone playing the text-adventure game "ZORK I" (Infocom), transcribe the on-screen text and create /app/solution.txt containing all the moves/commands the player inputs, one per line, in format like 'n' or 'get bag'.
